name: Our Escape
text: A type of prion virus called 'Zed' has spread like wild fire across the states. It turns people into zombies. We are not sure if the countless media repersentation of this enemy counts as prophecy or not. But the government has collapsed immedately under the pressure of this virus. Aside from this cookie cutter zombie lore, do you have any idea who you are?

uniques: Triggers a [Our Escape 2] event <hidden from users>

choices.text: I grew up in the barn, shut up.
uniques: Triggers a [Our Escape 2] event <hidden from users>

choices.text: This is the US army. Punk. We have not collapsed yet.
uniques: Triggers a [Our Escape 2] event <hidden from users>

name: Our Escape 2
text: That doesnt matter too much I guess, but I have to tell you something really Season. The zombies mutates. They grow faster stronger weirder and you have to keep up. Every year have 4 seasons and if you build a [Farm] right how its going to only bear fruit in [Autumn]. Your only source of population growth will be the [Migrating Population] early on. Proper population growth asks for proper source of food and safe environment. Good luck.

choices.text: It is weird you talk this much about common phenomeon, but thanks for the reminder.
